caption: "aileen wuornos" — 500,000+ searches this week. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about the woman closing Netflix's Lizzie Borden finale.

Why: Sarah Paulson plays Aileen Wuornos in the final episode of Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story, out since September 17: a jail interview, the stand, her execution. Ella Beatty, who plays Borden, calls the link "a legacy of female rage".

What most people don't know: Wuornos killed seven men in Florida between November 1989 and November 1990, all motorists. She first claimed self-defence, then dropped it. Florida executed her October 9, 2002. The 2003 film about her cost $1.5 million; Charlize Theron won an Oscar.
Very simply put: seven murders, six death sentences, one Oscar, not hers.

slides.headline: Abandoned at *four*, born on a leap day.
slides.sub: February 29, 1956, Rochester, Michigan. Her mother left in 1960; her grandparents adopted her on March 18 that year.

slides.sub: Monster, 2003. Charlize Theron gained 30 pounds and wore prosthetic teeth, and won the Oscar for Best Actress.
